title: Stylebook Wishlist Conversion Rate
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:wardrobe wishlist_group=* purchased=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(purchased="yes",1,0))) as matched by wishlist_group
| eval a_purchase_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_purchase_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Stylebook wishlist items that end with a purchase by wishlist group.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which wishlist group are helping or hurting Stylebook wishlist items.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a purchase` on `style:wardrobe` events and summarize the hit rate by `wishlist_group`.
visualization: Table of wishlist group with percentage of Stylebook wishlist items ending with a purchase.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often a purchase happens for each wishlist group so you can see where Stylebook wishlist items go smoothly or get stuck.
